settings.text:
Energy • Focus • Recovery
Built for the moments when performance matters.

IT STARTS AT A CELLULAR LEVEL.

NAD+ is a molecule found throughout your body and used by your cells every day. It plays a fundamental role in cellular energy production, but that is only part of its job.

NAD+ is also involved in cellular repair, signalling, maintenance and processes associated with healthy aging.

...And maintaining NAD+ becomes more difficult as we get older.

YOUR BODY NEEDS NAD+

NEU+ GIVES IT THE BUILDING BLOCK TO MAKE MORE.
One daily ritual. Two ways to enjoy it.

settings.text:
When life is full, you feel it.

In your energy.
Your focus.
Your routine
The way you show up - and sometimes, the way you look.

NEU+ supports the energy, focus and recovery you rely on to show up at your best.

Your spark, sustained.
Collagen support and a healthy, youthful glow.
Natural, sustained energy, no caffeine, no crash.

NEU+ contains 300mg Nicotinamide Riboside, or NR, a form of vitamin B3 your body can use as a precursor to NAD+. Rather than trying to deliver NAD+ itself, which is largely broken down when taken orally, NR gives your body a precursor it can use within its own NAD+ production pathway. Human clinical studies have shown oral NR can increase blood NAD+ related measures.
ONE SHOT EVERY DAY + PERFORMANCE-GRADE STANDARDS + MADE FOR DAILY LIFE + FEEL LIKE YOU AGAIN +

settings.study_ref: CLINICAL STUDY REF: Conze D, Brenner C, Kruger CL. Scientific Reports. 2019;9:9772.
